recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. Parliamentary constitutional monarchy.
rulers: King ABDALLAH II (since 7 February 1999); Prime Minister Jafar HASSAN (since 15 September 2024)
economy: upper-middle-income Middle Eastern economy; high debt and unemployment, especially for youth and women; global events triggering trade slump and decreased revenue from tourism; growing manufacturing and agricultural sectors; key US foreign assistance recipient; natural-resource-poor and import-reliant GDP (PPP): $109.986 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Jordanian Armed Forces (JAF; aka Arab Army): Jordanian Army (Jordanian Ground Forces; includes Special Operations Forces, Border Guards, Royal Guard), Jordanian Air Force, Jordanian Navy) Ministry of Interior: Public Security Directorate (includes national police, the Gendarmerie, and the Civil Defense Directorate) (2025) Expenditure: 4.5% of GDP (2024 est.)
origin: 25 May 1946 (from League of Nations mandate under British administration)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
